basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old motorcycle enthusiast from Brooklyn, New York. I recently got into Reddit to explore my interests in fantasy novels, gaming, and the joys of city riding. When I'm not working as a junior software developer, you can find me exploring the latest indie games or planning my next ride. I'm engaged to my high school sweetheart, and we love planning our wedding, which is how I stumbled upon WedditNYC. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a self-taught background in software development, having started with online courses and programming tutorials. My love for fantasy literature began in childhood with the Harry Potter series, and I enjoy discussing theories and connections within the books. Additionally, my interest in motorcycles has grown through years of riding and participating in local biking events.
